findings.problem: A caller could mutate SSML after entry validation during getCredential await, producing dispatched text different from reserved units/hash. Trusted local API integrity issue; not a remote web exploit.
findings.fix: Synchronous deep clone/freeze of plan/account before awaits; frozen exact dispatch payload and immutable price/endpoint/resource proof.
